page.notes: Uncertain readings: "suaue" (printed with a final letter that could be ue or uc) and "praestatia" are marked [?]. The abbreviation "alterius-ue" is printed as "alterius ue" with a superscript mark over the u; I read it as -ue. Printed "dilaudātes" and "expectātes" are kept with the macron as printed. Cropped marks at the left edge of the scan are from the neighbouring page and were not transcribed. A small ornamental mark appears between the running head words; it is not transcribed.
